name: engine-v2-research-lane
brief:
## Goal
Harden the goal/project engine using the bugs its first night exposed, then extend it with the deep-research lane Konrad asked for: a researcher role that can steer a real browser, reach external AI services (Perplexity; Gemini specifically for VIDEO quality assurance), plus pragmatic GitHub integration. This is 're-engineering the engineering system' — the engine you are running on is the subject of this project.

## Context
Engine code (forge-control): src/lib/project-tick.ts (orchestrator tick: prompts, promotion, reconciliation, heartbeats), src/db/projects.ts, src/lib/workspace.ts, src/routes/projects.ts, src/lib/cc-runner.ts (run spawning, role files from /root/.claude/agents/<role>.md, cached until executor restart). Read docs/plan corpora of past projects and the vault note 'AI OS/Goal Mode Design.md' for design intent. DB already accepts role 'researcher' and tier 'junior' (migration 0034). Browser automation available via the playwright-skill and hermes browser skills; check /opt/ai-os/.secrets/ for existing API keys before assuming any are missing.

## Known bugs from the first night (Phase: engine hardening — fix ALL of these)
1. DUPLICATE REVIEWER CHAINS: two reviewer tasks in the same round each spawned their own 'Fix cycle 1' builder + re-reviewer, and later duplicate deploy builders — reconcileReviewer() has no dedupe. Design a consolidation: multiple NEEDS_FIXES verdicts in one round must produce exactly ONE fix builder + ONE re-review (merge the feedback), and a PASS from one reviewer must not race another's NEEDS_FIXES.
2. BLOCKED PROJECTS KEEP RUNNING: promoteReadyTasks() and claimReadyTasks() ignore project status — a blocked/paused project's remaining rounds keep spawning runs. Gate both on projects.status = 'active'.
3. LIVE-CHECKOUT HOT-APPLY: fleet agents edited /opt/forge-ai-os (live) during build phases so reviewers could curl real endpoints — that caused unexplained forge-control restarts. Policy decision (design it properly): build phases are worktree-only; verification against live endpoints happens via an explicit, clearly-briefed deploy/verify task, never ad hoc. Encode the rule in the role prompts in project-tick.ts buildPrompt() and make reviewers check `git -C /opt/forge-ai-os status` cleanliness as part of their checklist.
4. EXECUTOR SELF-DEPLOY: when a project's diff touches executor-loaded code (src/lib/project-tick.ts, cc-runner.ts, executor.ts, src/db/*), pm2 restart would kill live runs. The deploy prompt/pattern must instead launch /opt/ai-os/scripts/safe-restart.sh forge-executor DETACHED (setsid nohup ... &) and end; the restart lands when the fleet is idle. Encode this in the goal-mode deploy guidance.

## Research lane (subsequent phases)
5. RESEARCHER ROLE: create /root/.claude/agents/researcher.md — mission: deep research with real sources; may steer a browser (playwright skill) for logged-in/web-app work; must cite what it saw; writes docs/research/*.md. Frontmatter tools should include Read, Write, Glob, Grep, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch, Skill. project-tick already has a researcher prompt branch.
6. GEMINI VIDEO QA: build a standalone CLI `bin/gemini-qa` (or scripts/) that takes a local video path or URL, sends it to the Gemini API, and returns structured QA JSON (hook/watch-points: pacing, audio glitches, visual artifacts, factual red flags, hook quality — design the rubric). Konrad wants this as the QA backbone for the video pipeline later. If no GEMINI/GOOGLE API key exists in /opt/ai-os/.secrets/, build it cleanly behind GEMINI_API_KEY, prove it against the API's error path, and queue a reminder via POST :7700/api/reminders telling Konrad exactly which key to add and where.
7. PERPLEXITY ACCESS: research the current Perplexity API; implement a thin search/ask helper behind PERPLEXITY_API_KEY with the same missing-key protocol. Browser-steering fallback is acceptable to document but do not build fragile scraping.
8. GITHUB: when a project's base repo has an origin remote and gh is authenticated: push the work branch at each phase completion (never force), and on project completion optionally open a PR instead of merging when the brief says so. Implement in the deploy guidance + a small helper; keep it boring.

## Definition of done
- All four engine bugs fixed with the behavior above, covered by unit tests where the logic is pure (reviewer-verdict consolidation, promotion gating — extract testable functions; there is a test precedent in src/lib/account-health.test.ts).
- researcher.md exists and a smoke researcher task can run end-to-end in a scratch project.
- gemini-qa and perplexity helpers exist, behave correctly with and without keys, with docs.
- GitHub push/PR behavior implemented and documented.
- npx tsc --noEmit clean in forge-control; existing tests plus new ones pass.

## Quality bar
Reviewers run tsc + the test suite, and for engine changes reason through the failure modes explicitly (double-fire, races between ticks, blocked-status transitions mid-round). One phase must include a red-team reviewer briefed to attack the reconciliation logic with concrete scenarios.

## Constraints / hard rules
- You are modifying the engine that runs you. Work ONLY in this worktree during build phases. NEVER edit /opt/forge-ai-os live during build phases. NEVER pm2 restart forge-executor — not even via a builder 'just to test'.
- Do NOT touch forge-control-web/app/desktop/** — a parallel project (operator-visibility) owns the web UI this cycle. API route changes are fine except routes/agents.ts (theirs).
- pnpm rules as always. Design tokens irrelevant here (no UI work).

## Deployment (final phase, only after reviewer PASS)
1. In /opt/forge-ai-os: merge main into your branch first if main moved, re-run tsc + tests in the worktree, then merge to main. Conflicts: STOP and report files.
2. pm2 restart forge-control (API side) is allowed. For the executor-side code: launch /opt/ai-os/scripts/safe-restart.sh forge-executor 43200 45 DETACHED (setsid nohup) and finish — do NOT wait for it.
3. Final message: what changed, test results, which keys/reminders Konrad owes the system.
